courses.title: Path to Wall Street (Investment)
courses.description: Build financial fluency from market basics to fundamental analysis, portfolio/risk management, and financial modeling & valuation. Practice with a trading simulator and finish with a stock-pitch capstone. We will use AI to screen companies, summarize earnings calls, and draft simple backtests to support decisions.

seo.metaTitle: Path to Wall Street Investment Program | SCISS Summer School
seo.metaDescription: Learn how markets work, analyze companies, and build a mock portfolio. Students craft a stock pitch, explore risk/reward, and practice ethical decision-making with our $1M virtual investment challenge.

outcomes: Master financial fluency and market analysis
Build and manage a diversified portfolio
Deliver a polished stock pitch presentation
Leverage AI tools to accelerate research and analysis
courses.prerequisites: None - appropriate for all skill levels with differentiated instruction

items.description: Viswise Academy flagship Youth Investment Courses from intro to advanced level

courses.title: Youth Innovation & Entrepreneurship (Teen Start-ups)
courses.description: From mindset to model to market, blend business-model design with design thinking. Test ideas through research, use modern AI tools to accelerate prototyping, and refine a story investors can believe in. We will use AI to conduct market research, generate branding assets, and draft pitch content faster.

seo.metaTitle: Youth Innovation & Entrepreneurship Program | SCISS Summer School
seo.metaDescription: From idea to pitch: design thinking, problem discovery, prototyping, and go-to-market. Teams build an MVP and pitch to a friendly panel of mentors for feedback and awards.

curriculum: AI-assisted brand kit & pitch deck creation
Customer discovery with AI surveys & synthesis
outcomes: Develop a complete MVP and business model
Use AI tools to accelerate prototyping
Apply AI to customer discovery and storytelling
Receive actionable feedback from mentors and awards
